title: Programmable Fax API end-of-life and removal
description: Twilio Programmable Fax API was retired and client.fax methods were removed from the twilio-node SDK.
oldBehavior: client.fax.v1.faxes allowed creating and managing faxes.
newBehavior: Programmable Fax is retired. Migrate to alternative messaging or third-party fax providers.

evidenceSources.summary: Programmable Fax endpoints removed from twilio-node SDK following service end of life.

assumptions: Usage of client.fax.v1.faxes indicates retired Programmable Fax API.
